fields.Address: 1220 Moser St, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: 810 Billiards & Bowling
fields.Short Description: Bowling, billiards and a milkshake bar at The Market Common, with a 3D haunted mini golf course.

fields.Address: 1808 21st Ave N, Unit A, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Hollywood Wax Museum
fields.Short Description: Wax figures and photo-op sets at Broadway at the Beach.

fields.Address: 913 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Ripley's Mirror Maze
fields.Short Description: Ripley's Mirror Maze is a perplexing puzzle of mirrors on Ocean Boulevard near the SkyWheel where visitors try to find their way out. It is a quick, indoor activity that suits families and groups, and sits next to Ripley's other Boardwalk-area attractions.

fields.Hours Note: Book a game time online or by phone. Arrive 15 minutes early; games start on time.
fields.Address: 400 N Kings Hwy, Suite D, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Escapology Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: Private escape games on North Kings Highway, each about 60 minutes (plan on 90 minutes total). Themes include Lost City, Mansion Murder, Star Trek, Saving Santa, Haunted House and Batman: The Dark Knight Challenge, so there is a game for movie fans and puzzle fans alike.

fields.Hours Note: Hours change week to week; check the museum's site or call before you go
fields.Address: 607 27th Ave N, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach Pinball Museum
fields.Price: $12 per person per hour; free play
fields.Short Description: A pinball museum with more than two dozen machines from the 1970s to today, all fully playable on Free Play. Come to look at the machines, then stay to play. Capacity is limited, so advance reservations are required.

fields.Hours Note: Studio visits Wed-Fri; call ahead for workshops
fields.Address: 708 12th Ave, Conway, SC 29526
fields.Name: Conway Glass
fields.Short Description: Conway Glass is a downtown studio and gallery where visitors can watch glassblowers at work. Hands-on glassblowing and stained glass workshops let beginners make their own piece to take home, which makes it a good rainy-day activity for couples, friends and families with older kids.

fields.Address: 4005 Howard Ave, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: EdVenture Myrtle Beach
fields.Price: $10; first responders, military and seniors $9; under 2 free
fields.Short Description: A hands-on children's museum at The Market Common with interactive exhibits that encourage problem-solving and imaginative play. It is built for children ages 0 to 10, with kindergarten through 5th grade the sweet spot, and has a second-floor toddler area for ages three and under.

fields.Address: 316 9th Ave N, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach Room Escape
fields.Short Description: Four 60-minute escape games near Ripley's, including The Witch's Castle and Jailbreak. Daily time slots; book ahead.

fields.Hours Note: Book a game time online. Park near Margaritaville and the Hampton Inn.
fields.Address: 1138 Celebrity Cir, Suite 323, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: The Escape Game Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: Teams are locked in a themed room at Broadway at the Beach and have 60 minutes to find clues, solve puzzles and escape. Six themes are offered, including Cosmic Crisis, Timeliner: Train Through Time, Gold Rush and The Depths, with multi-room sets and unlimited hints along the way.

fields.Name: Stars and Strikes
fields.Short Description: Bowling, augmented-reality bowling, virtual reality, laser tag, axe throwing and arcade games with a bar and restaurant in North Myrtle Beach. Use the website for the exact location and hours.

fields.Hours Note: Recent hours 9 AM–10 PM; check ripleys.com for today's hours.
fields.Address: 1110 Celebrity Cir, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Ripley's Aquarium
fields.Short Description: A large aquarium with a walk-through tunnel and touch tanks. Thousands of animals include sharks, sawfish, reef fish and rays, and a tunnel lets you walk under the sharks. Hands-on experiences, a play area and snacks are on site, which makes it a good stop for families on a rainy day.

fields.Name: Funplex Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: CLOSED: thefunplex.com says the Myrtle Beach location is closed (local news reported the closure Oct 30, 2024). Keep unpublished.

fields.Address: 915 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Ripley's Haunted Adventure
fields.Short Description: Ripley's Haunted Adventure on Ocean Boulevard is a walk-through haunted attraction built on spooky suspense and surprises, steps from the Boardwalk and SkyWheel. It is an indoor, rain-or-shine stop for teens and adults who want a scare. Check the Ripley's site for current hours.

fields.Hours Note: Call (843) 491-1444 for today's hours. Deals: 2 hours for $15 on Tuesdays, buy-one-get-one on Wednesdays.
fields.Address: 3820 S Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Big Air Trampoline Park
fields.Short Description: Trampolines for all ages, 40+ attractions, a Cosmic Nights session and a cafe. Attractions include trampoline courts, slam dunk courts, ninja-warrior courses, launch pads, freestyle courts, a zip line, a kids' Lil Ninja area and a mechanical shark. Jump passes come in several lengths, and memberships are available.

fields.Hours Note: Last ticket sold an hour before closing. Kids 4 and under free. Busiest on rainy days.
fields.Address: 1313 Celebrity Cir, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: WonderWorks
fields.Price: Ages 4 and under free; see the website for ticket prices
fields.Short Description: An upside-down building packed with hands-on science exhibits at Broadway at the Beach. More than 100 exhibits fill six Wonder Zones, from space discovery to an imagination lab, plus a glow-in-the-dark ropes course, a black-lit laser tag maze and a 6D motion ride. It is aimed at families with kids, and the outdoor Soar + Explore adds a zipline.

fields.Hours Note: Book a game time online. Kids under 6 play free with their family.
fields.Address: 9713 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Riddles Escape Room
fields.Short Description: Live-action escape rooms on North Kings Highway, each a 60-minute game. Themes are Space Odyssey, Outlaw Pursuit, Mystery Mansion, Shipwrecked and The Grande Strand Hotel, so there is a choice for sci-fi fans, Wild West buffs and mystery lovers alike.

fields.Address: 1116 Celebrity Cir, Unit 310C, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Black Flag Forge
fields.Short Description: At Broadway at the Beach, Black Flag Forge is a hands-on blacksmithing experience where expert smiths guide you through making your very own metal piece at the forge. It suits first-timers and works well for groups, couples and teens looking for something different from the usual arcade.

fields.Hours Note: Glow party Fri and Sat 20:00-22:00; call ahead for open jump times
fields.Address: 2200 N Oak St, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Sky Zone Myrtle Beach
fields.Price: 90-minute Open Jump $22.99; all-day unlimited $29.99; required Sky Socks $5
fields.Short Description: Sky Zone is an indoor trampoline park with open jump sessions, a Warped Wall, Ninja Warrior course, Battle Beam, Ultimate Dodgeball, aerial silks and the Sky Tower. Pleyo turns the trampolines into a video game, and a toddler-only Little Leapers morning session is offered for children six and under with a parent.

fields.Address: 1322 Celebrity Cir, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Dave & Buster's
fields.Short Description: Dave & Buster's at Broadway at the Beach is a big arcade with racing games, shooters, air hockey and basketball, plus screens showing football, basketball and hockey games. It also has a full food and drink menu, so groups can eat and play in one place on a rainy evening.

fields.Address: 304 SC-90 E, Unit A-1, Little River, SC 29566
fields.Name: Pin Point Indoor Pickleball & Golf
fields.Short Description: Pin Point is an indoor sports venue in Little River with nine pickleball courts and seven TrackMan golf simulators, so a rainy day does not cancel the game. A full bar and kitchen are on site, which makes it an easy stop for a group that wants to play and then stay a while.

fields.Hours Note: Book a game time online; hours change with the season. Kids 10 and under need a private game.
fields.Address: 1314 Celebrity Cir #165, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Backstage Escape Games
fields.Short Description: Three escape games at Broadway at the Beach: The Legend of Atlantis, The Haunting of Hyde House and a holiday-themed Krampus game, plus a Mirror Maze billed as infinite psychedelic reflections. Smaller groups may be paired with other players unless they book the whole room, and kids 10 and under need a private game.

fields.Address: 3607 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: AlleyOops North Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: Duckpin bowling, a golf simulator, games and a full restaurant.

fields.Address: Broadway at the Beach, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Backstage Mirror Maze & The Vault Laser Maze
fields.Short Description: At Broadway at the Beach, the Backstage Mirror Maze fills over 2,000 square feet of an Off Broadway theater's backstage with a 1933 bank-heist escape story, kaleidoscope glasses and colored lights. The Vault Laser Maze is a heist-style challenge through a web of security beams, with scores posted on a Top Ten list.

fields.Address: 3606 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Jack Axe Throwing
fields.Short Description: Axe throwing with a coach, plus golf simulators and a beer and wine bar. Reservations recommended; under 18 with an adult.

fields.Address: 901 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Ripley's Believe It or Not!
fields.Short Description: An oceanfront odditorium on North Ocean Boulevard with hundreds of unbelievable-but-true artifacts, along with interactive games and the stories behind the exhibits. It is an easy indoor stop for families on a rainy or hot day.

fields.Hours Note: Reservations required; book a game time online. Arrive 15 minutes early.
fields.Address: 314 Main St, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Break Out Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: Private, 60-minute escape rooms on Main Street in North Myrtle Beach. The six themes are Escape the Serial Killer, CSI 2: The Myrtle Murderer, Red Beard's Revenge, The Curse of Volcano Island, Zombie Outbreak and The Cannibal Collector, ranging from pirate adventure to spooky.

fields.Address: 1105 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: 810 Billiards & Bowling North Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: The North Myrtle Beach location of 810 Billiards & Bowling offers bowling, billiards and chess in a casual setting. It is one of three 810 locations on the Grand Strand, along with Market Common in Myrtle Beach and Conway, so groups can find a rainy-day game night close by.

fields.Address: 2001 Hwy 501 E, Conway, SC 29526
fields.Name: 810 Billiards & Bowling Conway
fields.Short Description: The Conway location of 810 Billiards & Bowling offers bowling, billiards and chess in a casual setting, a handy option for a group staying inland. It is one of three 810 locations on the Grand Strand, along with Market Common in Myrtle Beach and North Myrtle Beach.

fields.Hours Note: Private bookings only; book a game time online. Best for ages 13 and up.
fields.Address: 1120 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Captive Escape Rooms
fields.Short Description: Four private, themed escape rooms on North Kings Highway: Dracula's Library, Charlotte's Attic, Piece of Eight and 13 Doors. The first three take up to 8 players and 13 Doors takes up to 6, so a family or a group of friends can book a room to themselves.

fields.Address: 7621 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Name: Interactive Experience Unleashed
fields.Short Description: A VR playground and family entertainment center with eight VR attractions, including the mixed-reality Curse of Calypso with animatronics and mashups like Blaston and Jurassic: New Era. A 3,500-square-foot supervised kids' area has slides and ball pits, and arcade games, birthday parties and the Firebird Cafe round out a rainy-day stop.
